No supplier links found: searches for welded-part suppliers (vangs, arms, base plates, flanges) to these plants named no supplier; Kloeckner Metals sells machined base plates to pole makers but names no customer. Unlocated/unrecorded: Sabre Structures-PA (2012 news says 'outside Pittsburgh', city not named); Sabre Fort Worth/Hicksville status rests on 2015 article; CHM Industries second site at 700 E. McLeroy Blvd., Saginaw TX not recorded (role unknown); DIS-TRAN Eunice LA plant mentioned in a job posting, not verified; Meyer Utility Structures also has Mexico plants (out of scope); Meyer Bay Minette AL not confirmed; Arcosa Ameron Pole Products / Arcosa Traffic Structures / Arcosa Telecom (Oklahoma) steel plants belong to the lighting/traffic/telecom slice and were not located. Thomas & Betts / ABB: steel structures business (Meyer) was sold to Trinity (now Arcosa) in 2014, so no T&B row. TransAmerican Power Products: no US plant found, no row. Hapco (Abingdon VA) is lighting/traffic, left to that slice. IUSI (Batesville AR, ERW-welded poles) appears only in an old directory listing; not recorded. Stella-Jones Lincoln County TN (announced Apr 2026) is a lattice tower plant, out of scope, not recorded. Nucor Decatur AL: $60M expansion announced Oct 2026 (60 jobs) - a plant-level trigger within 24 months. Nucor Crawfordsville IN and Brigham City UT are excluded as not yet producing; coordinator may prefer to keep them as base with a trigger. Geocoding: street-address plants via Census; city-only plants use city centroid (geocode_method field) and need a street address before field use. Welder postings: job-board pages were mostly expired, blocked or aggregator-only; counts are what was seen, not confirmed open.
